items.title: JMIC shipping assessment documents persistent Hormuz traffic disruption
items.summary: The November 5 JMIC assessment reports attacks and persistently depressed commercial vessel movements through Hormuz relative to the 2025 baseline. US-assisted passages continued but fell slightly from the prior reporting period. These measurements establish ongoing maritime stress, not a new oil-volume loss caused by Friday's reported tanker incident.

observations.label: Reported attacks in Strait of Hormuz
observations.value: 4 across reporting period; 3 in previous period; incidents November 1-3

observations.label: Overall commercial transit vs historical baseline
observations.value: Substantially below 2025 levels; independent tracking showed single-digit to low-double-digit movements per day

observations.label: US-assisted vessel transits, current reporting period
observations.value: Approximately 31 per day, versus 34 per day during October 24-30; not equivalent to overall traffic

observations.label: Additional petroleum throughput lost on November 6

items.key_finding: JMIC data support ongoing severe Hormuz shipping stress, without demonstrating a new Friday petroleum-flow shock.

items.title: JFrog rallies sharply on strong cloud and AI software-supply-chain demand
items.summary: JFrog reported much faster cloud growth and expanding large-enterprise adoption in its third quarter. Shares surged after the results, distinguishing demonstrated recurring software demand from the broader AI-infrastructure selloff. A large intraday price gain increases valuation and execution risks despite stronger fundamentals.

items.title: Moderna swings to quarterly profit and lifts revenue outlook
items.summary: Moderna returned to profitability on stronger vaccine revenue and lower research costs, then raised its full-year sales outlook. The intraday share-price increase is supported by published company results, while its cancer-vaccine opportunity remains subject to regulatory and commercial uncertainty. COVID-vaccine sales still dominate revenue.

items.key_finding: Moderna's upside earnings surprise and guidance raise are material, with a separate unproven oncology commercialization path.

items.title: New UKMTO warning: outbound tanker reports waterline explosion near Hormuz
items.summary: UKMTO published Warning 197-26 on November 6 about an outbound tanker reporting an explosion near Khasab, Oman, on November 5. The crew is safe and the vessel continued under its own power. The warning establishes a fresh maritime security incident report but not attacker identity, a new transit shutdown, or measured lost oil supply.

observations.label: Reported incident time and location
observations.value: November 5, 22:00 UTC; 16 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman

observations.label: Vessel and crew status
observations.value: Outbound tanker, waterline explosion on port side; crew safe; vessel proceeding under own power

observations.label: Verified physical-flow impact
observations.value: No confirmed wider reduction in tanker transit or petroleum throughput from this warning

items.key_finding: An independently documented UKMTO tanker incident renews Hormuz security risk without establishing disrupted regional oil flows.

sources.title: UK Maritime Trade Operations — Recent incidents, Warning 197-26

items.title: US chip shares rebound after global rout, with breadth still mixed
items.summary: US chipmakers rebounded sharply in Friday's morning trading after Thursday's extreme selling, helping lift the Nasdaq while the Dow lagged. The recovery signals a partial reversal in positioning, not verified improvement in semiconductor orders or data-center deployment economics. Higher Treasury yields and narrow leadership could challenge durability.
